gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.663831 44.964816)',4326)::geography, 1600)
  AND p.leisure = 'park'
  AND elev.z >= 220;

WITH mcw_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Medical College of Wisconsin-Central Wisconsin'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Wausau'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'WI'
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geometry::geometry, 1600) AS geom
  FROM mcw_geometry
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, true, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area)) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(clipped_raster, true) AS elevation_counts
  FROM clipped_dem
),
park_candidates AS (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM parks p, mcw_geometry m
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geometry, m.geometry::geometry, 1600)
    AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
final_park AS (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM parks p, mcw_geometry m
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geometry, m.geometry::geometry, 1600)
    AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
    AND ST_Value(rast, p.geometry::geometry, true) >= 220
    FROM public.dem_us
)
SELECT 'Park within 1600 meters and elevation >= 220 m' AS result;
